current_task_corrections.correction: Change the denial_rate component's denominator parameter from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims'. The denominator must include only claims with status Paid, Denied, or Adjusted; exclude Pended claims that have not yet been decided.

Change the monthly_trend component's date_column parameter from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from'. Service dates represent when care was delivered; adjudication dates lag service by variable amounts and create temporal inconsistency.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing denial rates in claims analysis, always use adjudicated claims (status in {Paid, Denied, Adjusted}, excluding Pended) as the denominator. Including pending claims understates the rate because their ultimate status remains undecided. Always record and communicate the denominator choice.

When generating monthly volume or financial trends, key the aggregation on service_date_from rather than adjudication_date. Adjudication dates lag service delivery and vary inconsistently across claims, distorting temporal patterns in the trend.
